summary.name: BondAI
summary.one_liner: BondAI is an AI agent framework distributed as a Docker image (krohling/bondai) that runs from the command line with an OpenAI API key.
use_cases: running an AI agent locally in a container
trying out an OpenAI-powered agent from the command line
persisting agent files in a mounted local folder
summary.what_it_does: The Docker Hub page lists the krohling/bondai image (about 258 MB) and gives a quick-start command. The usage example mounts a local agent-volume directory into the container, sets the working directory there, and passes an OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable, then launches the bondai command. The page points to a separate homepage (bondai.dev) for documentation, examples and API specification, which are not included in this page text. The image was last updated almost three years before the page was captured.
notable: Distributed as a ready-to-run Docker image on Docker Hub
Requires an OpenAI API key to run
Mounts a local volume so agent files persist outside the container
caveats: Docker image was last updated almost 3 years ago, so it may be out of date
Uses OpenAI, so an OpenAI API key is needed
